en: Vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a young woman with long wavy hair and flowers in her hair, wearing a light-colored lace-trimmed dress with a corseted waist and floral decorations. She is seated, holding flowers in her lap. The lower part of the image includes printed credits and a caption with her name and the role 'Undine'. The style and typography resemble early 20th‑century European photographic postcards.
